# Recreation Prompt

Recreate the source as **Love Heist in the Fog**, a mobile-first browser canvas game inspired by fogbound psychological horror and romantic heist melodrama. Preserve the real mechanic truth: a two-lane endless runner where tapping/clicking or pressing Space/Arrow toggles the avatar between lanes, rewards add exactly one point, hazards end the run, speed accelerates, and restart resets the score and entities.

The player is The Valentine Warden, a trench-coated heist crew leader carrying a heart-vault satchel through an abandoned resort town. Rewards are glowing rose vow-lockets; hazards are siren pylons/guilt obelisks. The HUD calls score "Vows" and failure "The Fog Found Us." The scene should be procedurally drawn with wet road bands, drifting fog, barred hotel silhouettes, a heart-shaped vault moon, red scarf/rose motifs, and compact gothic-romantic UI. Use catalog-approved Creepster and Rajdhani fonts and failure-tolerant dark/romantic media accents only after user gesture.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: Mobile-first two-lane endless runner on an HTML canvas.
- objective: Keep moving, collect beneficial items for score, and avoid obstacles that cause game over.
- input model: Pointer/tap on the canvas or Space/ArrowUp/ArrowDown toggles the avatar between two lanes; start/restart/mute use normal buttons.
- core loop: Start from menu, avatar remains near the left side, entities spawn offscreen right and scroll left, player switches between two vertical lanes to meet rewards and avoid hazards, score increments by one on reward collision, speed ramps upward over time, hazard collision ends the run, restart resets state.
- fail/friction state: Immediate game-over overlay after hazard collision; final score displayed; restart returns to the beginning of the same loop.

## Protected mechanics
- Two-lane toggle input and keyboard equivalents.
- Avatar x-position, lane interpolation, and simple readable collision envelope.
- Right-to-left entity spawning, scroll speed, acceleration, and spawn spacing cadence.
- Reward collection increments score by exactly 1 and removes the reward.
- Hazard collision immediately changes to game-over state and reveals restart UI.
- HUD score visibility during play and score reset on restart.
- Mobile button click paths remain native and are not globally touch-suppressed.

## Remixed target
A romantic fog-horror heist runner: the player is a trench-coated crew leader escaping a Silent-Hill-inspired resort town with stolen vow-lockets, switching between two cursed lanes to gather romantic proofs while dodging siren pylons and guilt obelisks. The mechanics stay the same; the art, HUD, background, feedback, audio tone, and world language are rebuilt around fog, longing, vaults, roses, sirens, and doomed devotion.
